# opensearch_workspace (Resource)

Provides an OpenSearch workspace resource. Workspaces allow you to segregate your OpenSearch Dashboards into multiple tenants. This feature is available in OpenSearch 2.18 and later. Please refer to the [OpenSearch Dashboards workspace documentation](https://docs.opensearch.org/docs/latest/dashboards/workspace/workspace/) for details.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Create a workspace
resource "opensearch_workspace" "analytics" {
  name        = "analytics-workspace"
  description = "Workspace for analytics team"
  features    = ["discover", "visualize", "dashboard"]
}

# Create a workspace with minimal configuration
resource "opensearch_workspace" "simple" {
  name = "simple-workspace"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the workspace.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Description of the workspace.
- `features` (Set of String) List of features enabled for this workspace.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `workspace_id` (String) The ID of the workspace.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell
terraform import opensearch_workspace.analytics <workspace-id>
```
